ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure marks the locations of Chengdu, Chongqing, Wuhan, and Shanghai. Chengdu and Chongqing are located in the western inland area of the figure; Wuhan is located in the central part, near the Yangtze River route; Shanghai is located in the easternmost coastal area. Then reason: Compared with Shanghai Pudong New Area, the Chengdu-Chongqing Experimental Zone does not have the advantage of a coastal port; compared with the Wuhan Urban Circle, the Chengdu-Chongqing Experimental Zone also has weaker conditions as an external water-land transportation hub. raw_record.question_text:
Shanghai Pudong New Area, the Chengdu-Chongqing Experimental Zone, and the Wuhan Urban Circle are three experimental zones in our country. Read the "schematic diagram of the locations of the three experimental zones".

<image1>

What is the main socioeconomic reason restricting the development of the "Chengdu-Chongqing Experimental Zone"?

method.method_draft: 根据题干确定要找的是“成渝实验区”的主要社会经济制约因素。先描述图像：图上上海位于东部沿海，武汉位于中部、长江沿线，成都和重庆位于西部内陆。再将成渝与上海浦东新区、武汉城市圈比较：浦东有沿海港口优势，武汉处于中部水陆交通枢纽，而成渝远离海洋、对外联系通道相对少。最后将这种区位差异转化为社会经济因素，回答为交通不便。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中标出了成都、重庆、武汉、上海的位置。成都和重庆位于图的西部内陆地区；武汉位于中部、长江沿线附近；上海位于最东部沿海地区。再推理：与上海浦东新区相比，成渝实验区没有沿海港口优势；与武汉城市圈相比，成渝实验区的对外水陆交通枢纽条件也较弱。成渝地处西部内陆，对外联系通道相对少，因此制约其发展的主要社会经济原因是交通不便。
